figma.frameName: Harmony Gates / Progression Run / FINAL / DEMO 01
figma.prototypePurpose: Demonstrate reusable progression-track motion. Chords in the prototype are sample runtime data and must never be hard-coded.
figma.movableLayers: TRACK ITEM / 00 and subsequent TRACK ITEM layers keep the same names across prototype states so Smart Animate moves them between fixed path positions.

visualSource: Figma node 44:5 / SOURCE / Progression Run Approved
productionRule: One reusable renderer accepts arbitrary progression data at runtime. Never create a screen or hard-coded layout per progression.

trackRenderer.recyclingRule: Render the seven visible positions and recycle items as activeIndex changes. Progression length does not change screen architecture.
trackRenderer.alignmentRule: Orb center, diameter and pedestal are calibrated against approved source node 44:5. All prototype states reuse these same seven slot geometries exactly.

advanceAnimation.behavior: Each visible chord moves one path position toward the player. The completed chord becomes previous history, the next chord reaches the play-point and receives the active gold treatment, and a new upcoming event enters at the far end. The environment stays fixed.
advanceAnimation.interruptPolicy: Do not start a second advance while the current animation is running. Queue at most one valid advance event.

requirements: Evaluate the ChordEvent at activeIndex, not the rendered text.
Wrong or incomplete chords never advance.
Do not advance twice from a held chord or sustain state.
Require a new qualifying note-state after each accepted advance.
Respect root, bass, inversion, omission and voicing-family policies from ChordEvent.
Figma clicks simulate the event only; production advancement comes from MIDI recognition or explicit manual Next.

endBehavior.loopFalse: After the final event is completed, run the finish animation and show results.
endBehavior.loopTrue: Recycle the first event into the far-upcoming position and continue seamlessly.
